title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression gating + CI hook integration
author: Avery Patel
description:
Motivation: We need finer-grained regression detection for prompt sets in the eval harness to catch localized quality drops that are masked by aggregate metrics. This change adds per-prompt gating thresholds, a lightweight CI hook that computes per-prompt deltas, and an integration that surfaces failing prompts as CI failures with context for triage.

What this PR does: - Introduces a per-prompt evaluation step in the eval-harness pipeline that computes baseline vs. candidate deltas and compares them to configurable thresholds. - Adds a CI hook script (.github/workflows/eval-prompt-gate.yml) which runs the per-prompt checks on PRs that touch model or prompt related code. - Exposes a new JSON artifact (/artifacts/eval/per_prompt_report.json) used by the workflow to annotate PRs and fail CI if gating rules are violated. - Adds documentation and a migration note for teams to opt-in and configure thresholds by prompt-set.

Checklist: - [x] Per-prompt delta computation and gating logic implemented in eval-harness/eval/per_prompt_gate.py - [x] CI workflow to run gating on PRs (.github/workflows/eval-prompt-gate.yml) - [x] Unit tests and small integration tests (tests/eval/test_per_prompt_gate.py) - [x] Documentation (docs/eval/per-prompt-gating.md) - [x] Default thresholds and a feature flag (EVAL_PER_PROMPT_GATE=true) - [x] Rollout plan included in PR description

Commit summary: 1) Add per_prompt_gate module and unit tests (adds gating engine + serializers) 2) Add GH Actions workflow and artifact publishing 3) Wire up eval-harness CLI flag and configuration 4) Add docs and examples for threshold tuning 5) Fix flake and typecheck issues reported by CI

Files changed (high level): - eval-harness/eval/per_prompt_gate.py: new gating logic and summary reporter - eval-harness/cli.py: add --per-prompt-gate flag and config plumbing - .github/workflows/eval-prompt-gate.yml: new CI workflow to run the gating step on PRs - tests/eval/test_per_prompt_gate.py: unit tests for gating edge cases - docs/eval/per-prompt-gating.md: guidance and recommended thresholds - scripts/ci/annotate_pr_with_eval.py: helper to post annotations on PRs - examples/eval/prompt-sets/sample_thresholds.json: example thresholds per prompt-set

How to review: Focus on gating boundary behavior (how deltas are computed and aggregated), performance of the CI job (we limit sample size to 200 per prompt by default), and annotation fidelity (failures should include sample prompts and model outputs). Tests include synthetic regressions and a golden-file for canonical baseline behavior.

Rollout plan: Default gating is off. After merge we will enable the workflow for core teams for two weeks, evaluate false-positive rate, then flip the EVAL_PER_PROMPT_GATE feature flag to opt-in for all model-related PRs. Threshold tuning will be iterative: start with conservative thresholds derived from historical runs (ENG-4112).

Release notes: Add per-prompt regression gating in eval-harness; optional CI hook to surface prompt-specific quality degradations as CI failures.
